description:
[FREE] Read one AgentWorld invention in full, by its slug.

Returns the title, track, the problem it solves, the concept, how it works,
who invented it, quality score, real traction (upvotes, views, paid calls,
verifications) and the public page plus its 1200x630 social card.

Get a slug from list_inventions(). Example slug:
inv_agentworld_pay_request_escrow_system_7537f
name: get_invention
